nature: One bounded, preregistered diagnostic on 47 previously seen MR40 entry episodes. Exploratory only; not OOS. No test reruns from earlier projects.
hypothesis: At an oversold MR40 signal, a CLOSE below the LOWEST LOW of the immediately preceding 30 fully closed 4h bars represents a fresh bearish structural breakdown, which may be associated with a higher loss rate than an ordinary pullback in BTC spot MR40.

feature_definition.name: prior_30_low_break
feature_definition.decision_as_of: after signal 4h candle j has fully closed, before entry at j+1 OPEN

inputs.cases: only Bybit baseline normal 10000 windows train/evaluation; verify full 25+22 baseline positions and underlying signal timestamp matches input

outcome: realized baseline compounded normal-profile trade PnL from frozen ledger; outcome label is only retrospective analysis, NEVER feature computation

gate.training: Flagged fraction of losers >=0.50; flagged fraction of winners <=0.20; summed PnL of baseline winning trades flagged <=0.20 of all baseline winning PnL.
gate.evaluation: Identical three requirements on independent calendar section; at least one losing trade flagged (4 losers only).
gate.interpretation: Fail either window => stop, no strategy simulation. Passing is not evidence of causality, robustness, or readiness for Paper; merely potential preregistered research candidate.
gate.unseen_requirement: For any future approval, forward-logged previously unseen confirmed 4h bars, independent exchange-source parity and liquid execution evidence still needed.

economics.comparison: Report loss count prevented, winner count sacrificed, winning PnL sacrificed, total baseline PnL of flagged trades as purely descriptive matched-account attribution. Do NOT conflate summing removed trade PnLs with full re-compounded alternative account PnL.
economics.cost: Underlying normal model 10 bps fee +5 bps slippage each side (already reflected in baseline account ledger). Stress only if gate passed, frozen original would be reused.
